justification: Function accesses user-supplied set element data without complete bounds checking of the element structure.
analysis: The function reads from attacker-influenced data through the 'elem' parameter which contains user-supplied set element data. The function does not perform overflow/underflow checks on any arithmetic operations and there are no obvious use-after-free patterns, but the reliance on potentially malformed user data without complete validation poses a risk.
